objective: Make Bob's LoRA training prove real weight updates on real dataset samples before running long 10k or 116k jobs.
what_was_done: Stopped the bad v8 llama-finetune-qlora run after checkpoints stayed byte-identical to v7.
Parametrized the v9 training gate so it supports both preflight smoke and real calibration runs.
Downgraded smoke status: 4-row smoke is now preflight-only and must not be treated as proof of useful training.
Changed the v9 gate default to calibration mode, requiring real dataset rows, enough train steps, train_loss, val_loss, and a changed adapter hash.
Attempted 500-row calibration with rank=16, alpha=32, freeze_layers=24; it failed fast with CUDA device-not-ready before training completed.
Reran 500-row calibration with a conservative config: rank=8, alpha=16, freeze_layers=36, gpu_layers=36, ctx=512, ubatch=128, val_split=0.05.
Removed competing smoke finetune processes that were consuming VRAM during calibration.
Validated the 500-row calibration with train_steps=2304, train_loss=1.8429, val_loss=1.8610, and a final adapter hash different from v7/v8/zero-step init.
Ran a real 10-example microtrain from train_finance_10k.jsonl using the same conservative profile and an explicit microtrain threshold.
Validated the 10-example microtrain with train_steps=32, train_loss=1.7748, val_loss=2.0213, and a final adapter hash different from v7/v8/zero-step init.
Started the real 10k training run with the conservative profile: rank=8, alpha=16, freeze_layers=36, gpu_layers=36, ctx=512, ubatch=128, val_split=0.05.
Stopped the 10k training run on operator request at data=17610/46964, elapsed=01:40:53, loss=1.81640, acc=66.19%.
Confirmed the 10k run did not produce a partial LoRA adapter because it was launched with save-every=0 and stopped before final save.
Confirmed no llama-finetune-qlora or v9 training process remains active and GPU memory returned to idle.

risks: The 500-row calibration proves real training but is not yet the production adapter.
Rank 16/top-24 failed on this 16 GB GPU with CUDA device-not-ready; production should start from the conservative rank 8/top-12 profile unless another benchmark proves otherwise.
The 30B MoE QLoRA path still logs unsupported CLAMP backward skips; quality must be judged with output tests before promoting.
External shell processes attempted additional smoke runs during calibration and had to be killed to avoid VRAM contention.
The 4-row smoke is not a quality or learning proof; it only checks that the finetune binary can execute.
The 10-example microtrain proves real update mechanics on real data but is too small to promote as a production adapter.
The stopped 10k run has no resumable LoRA checkpoint because save-every was 0.
Future long runs should set periodic checkpoint saving before launch if the operator may pause mid-run.
No GitHub operation is allowed; repository remains disk-only.
next_steps: Keep the 500-row calibration adapter as the latest valid non-production LoRA evidence.
If restarting 10k, add periodic save support before launch so a manual stop leaves a real adapter checkpoint.
Evaluate generated tool-calling behavior before replacing the active Bob LoRA.
